description: This file is a Polymer component definition for 'iron-localstorage', an element that manages synchronization with the Web Storage API (localStorage). It provides properties and methods to load, save, and monitor stored data, supporting JSON serialization and event handling for storage changes.

classes.name: Polymer
classes.description: The main Polymer framework object used to define the custom element.

methods.name: _handleStorage
methods.description: Handles the storage event to reload the component's data if the relevant key has changed.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the data from localStorage, useful when external changes are detected.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads the value from localStorage into the component, parsing JSON unless useRaw is true.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current value to localStorage, converting to JSON unless useRaw is true. Handles deletion if value is null.
